track_p2_forced_structure_reduction.description: Forced 1-regular perfect matching on Gamma_1(0) under lambda=1 for k=14
Forced bijection between Gamma_2(0) (M=84) and non-matched pairs of Gamma_1(0) for k=14
Forced inner-outer coordinate balance [m(a) in P_u] + deg_{N(a)}(u) = 2 (Constraint 4 of arXiv:2608.11211 / Lemma 4.8 of arXiv:2308.02978) for k=14
Forced outer pair common-neighbor reduction E(u,v) + |CN_{Gamma_2(0)}(u,v)| = 2 - |P_u cap P_v| (Constraints 2 & 3 of arXiv:2608.11211)
Exactness and uniqueness of the forced-structure reduction on the validation benchmark srg(9, 4, 1, 2) (blocking the unique K_3 box K_3 outer 4-cycle)
